text:
dina: kicking off onboarding for LlamaX-7B (int4) — perf bring-up + quant experiments. goal: baseline latency/throughput, ctx sweeps, and quick quality regressions. need owners + a short bench checklist.

rahul: what datasets/evals do you want for quality checks?

dina: start with helix_eval_1k (summarization), codegen-200 (short), and convo-safety 500. cc @marta for eval harness.

evan: I'll run the perf suite on dev-gpu-2. suggested quick command to reproduce my run: 
```
./bench.sh --model /models/llamax-7b/int4 \n  --dtype=int4 --batches 1,4,8 --ctx 512,2048,8192 \n  --repeat 5 --warmup 50 --kv-cache=true --no-stream
```

rahul: add --profile-kernel and --save-profiles for kernel selection traces. also capture memory peaks.

liz: once we have a stable perf baseline, I can push a canary to dedicated-llamax pool and route 5% traffic. will set fallback to r410.

perf-bot: Job queued: bench/llamax-7b-int4-evan-1758709123 (estimated 45m).

evan: quick raw numbers from first pass (dev-gpu-2, cuda-kern):
```
bs=1 ctx=512  p50=55ms  p95=120ms  tok/s=18
bs=4 ctx=2048 p50=140ms p95=310ms  tok/s=95
bs=8 ctx=2048 p50=220ms p95=480ms  tok/s=120
mem_peak=12.8GB (int4)
```

marta: quality snapshot (helix_eval_1k): baseline fp16 rouge=32.1, int4 rouge=31.4 (drop 0.7). summarization threshold is 1.0 pt, so it's under threshold but close. codegen correctness dropped 0.6% on our small set.

rahul: let's run a q-type sweep: q4_0, q4f, nf4, and lp8. also try per-channel scale (pql4) and different kernel choices (cutlass64 vs cuda-k) — sometimes kernel changes affect perf/regression.\
evan: plan: run sweep in parallel (5 runs each) capturing p50/p95/throughput, mem, and eval metrics. script: 
```
./bench_sweep.py --model /models/llamax-7b \n  --qtypes q4_0,q4f,nf4,lp8 --kernels cutlass64,cuda-k \n  --batches 1,4,8 --ctx 512,2048 --repeat 5 --eval-sets helix_eval_1k,codegen-200
```

dina: assign owners: perf bench = evan, quant experiments & qtype analysis = rahul, quality evals = marta, canary deployment = liz. please post results in this thread.

liz: I'll create the canary route after we pick the qtype variant that meets quality (<=1.0 rouge drop) and latency SLOs (p95 <= 2x fp16 baseline). will alert on p95 > 2x.

rahul: note — for nf4 we need to run calibration (llama-optimize --calibrate) to reduce distribution shift. will add calibration step in pipeline.

evan: initial observations: q4f has slightly better latency (-5-8%) than q4_0 on cuda-k, nf4 shows best quality but memory slightly higher. will post full table.

perf-bot: bench/llamax-7b-int4-evan-1758709123 completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/llamax/1758709123/ (profiles + metrics).

marta: I'll run full evaluation once evan uploads the sweep outputs. if any test drops >1.0 rouge or >2% codegen correctness we'll flag for reject.

dina: next steps checklist (short):
- [ ] evan: run full qtype+kern sweep and upload CSVs + flamegraphs (ETA EOD)
- [ ] rahul: run calibration + per-channel tests for nf4/pql4 (ETA 24h)
- [ ] marta: run full eval sets and post summary (ETA 36h)
- [ ] liz: prepare canary route + alerting (ready after variant chosen)

evan: started running sweep now, will comment with summary table when done.

dina: perfect. thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for onboarding notes. ping me if you hit weird kernel OOMs or reproducibility issues. :thumbsup:
